name: Grunge Marketing
tagline: Red-yellow torn-paper marketing deck with black distressed textures, collage photo frames, heavy block type, scribbles, and rough underlines.

palette.description: Saturated red and yellow paper, white torn fields, black ink marks, and grayscale collage imagery.

typography.style: Heavy block display type with condensed all-caps captions and distressed collage marks.

best_for: Campaign proposals, creative marketing lessons, bold event decks, and youth-culture concept presentations.
avoid_for: Quiet executive reviews, conservative board materials, or premium luxury decks.

source_inspiration.name: SlidesCarnival Grunge Style
source_inspiration.notes: Rebuilt as source-inspired portable HTML/CSS from public visual references; no source asset files are embedded.
